title: aristida fasciculata var. micrantha
intro: Aristida fasciculata var. micrantha, commonly known as small-spiked three-awn grass or small-spiked grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Aristida fasciculata var. micrantha are attributed to its ability to modulate immune response, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
